def get_row(lst, x):
    result = []
    for i, row in enumerate(lst):
        coordinates = [(i, j) for j, value in enumerate(row) if value == x]
        coordinates.sort(key=lambda coord: coord[1], reverse=True)
        result.extend(coordinates)
    return result
